help_what: Is your panel personal dentro of it network of exchange. Aqui ves who eres dentro of the system, that puedes hacer and that dispositivos of seguridad tienes asociados.
help_purpose: Shows your informacion personal, your level of member, your dispositivos of seguridad (Passkeys), your tarjetas NFC and your history of transactions recientes.
help_usage: Only lectura. There is no forms aqui. For change the PIN of a tarjeta NFC usa the boton Change PIN junto a each tarjeta. For pedir that it assembly revise your ascenso of level, pulsa Pedir ascenso.
help_info_user: your name of start of sesion.
help_info_balance: cuanto tienes available in your currency local.
help_info_status: state of your membresia (active, suspendida, etc.).
help_level: Is it categoria that define your limites of credito/debito, your derechos (voz, vote, quorum) and your permissions. Cuanto mas participes, mas subiras of level.
help_limits: The limite of credito is the maximo that puedes owe (balance negativo). The limite of debito is the maximo that puedes tener a favor (balance positivo). Them define your level of member.
help_passkeys: Are dispositivos with them that puedes start sesion without contrasena: huella, FaceID, PIN of the movil, llaves of seguridad USB.
help_nfc: Tarjetas fisicas asociadas a your account for pay in terminales NFC of them comercios. Each tarjeta has a UID unico.
help_pin: Is a codigo of 4 digitos that protege your tarjeta NFC. Itself pide to the hacer payments in terminales with teclado.
help_activity: Your ultimas 10 transactions (income in green, egresos in rojo).
profile_over_limit_desc: Your balance this by debajo of your limite. No puedes hacer new compras until regularizar.
profile_uuid_label: ID of account (UUID) for payments manuales:
profile_uuid_hint: Comparte this ID with who quiera enviarte a payment manual. Tambien this dentro of your codigo QR.
profile_docs_desc: Adds all your documents: cedula, pasaporte, carnet of conducir, etc. It comparacion between nodes federated itself makes by tipo + numero + pais. No can haber two documents iguales of the same pais.
profile_country_hint: The country is required to avoid duplicates: two ID numbers from the same country cannot have the same number, but an ID from Venezuela and one from Colombia can have the same number without issue.
profile_no_level: Without level asignado. Pide a ascenso for that it assembly you asigne a level.
profile_sponsor_hint: Your padrino you asigno part of its limite. When subas of level, the limite of your padrino itself libera automaticamente.
profile_no_sponsor: No tienes padrino. Your limite comes of your level of member.
profile_passkeys_desc: Puedes registrar multiples dispositivos: huella, FaceID, PIN of the movil, llave of seguridad USB, etc. Each one you permitira start sesion without contrasena.
profile_passkey_modal_desc: Dale a name a this dispositivo for identificarlo (ej: "My celular", "Huella laptop", "Llave USB"). Then your navegador you pedira confirm with huella, PIN, FaceID or it llave of seguridad.
profile_auth_hint: By seguridad, confirma your contrasena antes of continue. This evita that someone mas cambie your tarjeta if dejaste it sesion open.
profile_doc_for_card: Document a use in it tarjeta
profile_default_doc: Use the default of the user
profile_doc_for_card_hint: The POS pedira this document to the pay with this tarjeta.
profile_deactivate_desc: It tarjeta itself desactivara and no podra usarse for payments until that it vuelvas a activate.
profile_activate_desc: It tarjeta itself activara and podra usarse for payments nuevamente.
